author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description: With Adepticon in full swing, come hang out with the GMG Community as we yap about the Wednesday Reveals! We'll check out some new stuff from Catalyst Game Labs and watch the GW Previews together! This is normally Patron stuff but they're kind enough to let you all in. Let's gooooo!
title: Adepticon 2026 - Wednesday Night Reveals Commentary
